about: The buildings that aren't in a village: the cabins, by id, in the rows a mod edits (docs/design/builders.md section 4; Buildings.cs). Their cells stand as the valley was baked, in "built" (spans [y, x0, x1, ...] from "at", by terrain), and "site" is where ValleyShape puts each in metres, with the way its door faces. Village buildings are read from world/villages.json and the cells, with ids like Hollowmere#4. A row with walls and no "built" is laid over the cells at the start (WorldBuildings.LayInto) and drawn from its row, so cells.txt and things.json stay as they are. Append, never insert: an id is its place in this list.
